lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in at least five primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-spot distance increasing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear pattern of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance superior edges to shadowed inferior edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of discrete high-luminance spots distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a cluster of small, elongated teleost fish (likely remoras) located ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
